newsitem.title: USA: Manitowoc Q4 net up on sales gain.
newsitem.headline: Manitowoc Q4 net up on sales gain.

text.p: Manitowoc Co Inc said Monday a big sales increase helped earnings rise sharply in the fourth quarter ended December 31.

The company said net income totaled $4.2 million, or $0.36 a share, up from $3.8 million, or $0.34 a share, one year ago. The latest results included an after-tax charge of $1.2 million, or $0.06 a share, for the consolidation and closing of two refrigeration equipment plants in Iowa and Tennessee.
Sales for the period reached $115 million, up from $82 million in the corresponding period in 1995.
Manitowoc manufactures ice cube machines, dispensers and refrigeration equipment for the foodservice industry.
Its shares closed up one Monday at 36-7/8.
